note: Facility projects described in S&P 100 annual reports. 'claim' paraphrases what the 10-Ks say; the sentences themselves are in sites/results/filings.md (from scripts/sites-filings.mjs). claim_year is the fiscal year of the first 10-K in the set that describes the project as committed or under construction; filings rarely give a ground-breaking date. Coordinates were placed by eye on Sentinel-2 images and mark the center of the construction area, not a company-given location.

claims.claim: FY2020 10-K: Gigafactory Texas in Austin is under construction; FY2021 10-K: it will begin production in 2022.

claims.site: Ohio One fabs, Licking County OH
claims.claim: FY2022 10-K: Intel broke ground on two new leading-edge chip factories in Ohio. FY2024 10-K: completion of the Ohio facility has been slowed.
FY2022 10-K: TI started construction on SM1 and SM2 in Sherman, Texas. FY2024 10-K: equipping SM1, still building SM2.

FY2022 10-K: Tennessee incentives for Ford's new EV assembly plant, and BlueOval SK battery plants in Tennessee that the joint venture will build. FY2024: the joint venture is building them. (The 10-Ks do not use the name BlueOval City.)

claims.site: Ultium Cells battery plant, Lordstown OH
claims.claim: FY2020 10-K: GM has announced plans to mass-produce battery cells at Ultium Cells LLC in Lordstown, Ohio. Later 10-Ks give the location as Warren, Ohio.

claims.site: Lebanon manufacturing site, Boone County IN
claims.claim: FY2022 10-K: Lilly committed more than $2 billion to two new manufacturing facilities in Lebanon, Indiana. Later 10-Ks say only 'new facilities in Indiana'.

claims.site: Golden Pass LNG export terminal, Sabine Pass TX
claims.claim: Golden Pass LNG (ExxonMobil joint venture) took its investment decision in 2019 and is adding liquefaction trains at the existing import terminal. Not yet checked against the 10-K text: the filing step could not find ExxonMobil's 10-Ks in the SEC feed.

claims.site: Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4, Waynesboro GA
claims.claim: FY2023 10-K: Georgia Power placed Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 in service on July 31, 2023 and April 29, 2024. Construction began about 2013, before this archive, so this site is a control: it shows what 10 m imagery cannot see.
